regime.definition: For each side: unchanged executable entry price and strictly increased displayed entry quantity versus last prior consumed valid full book; narrow spread and young source revision. Aggregate displayed replenishment is not an order identity or sponsor inventory.

controls.wrong_race: Explicit frozen alternative race map, never guessed; missing mapping unavailable.
controls.local_bbo: Unchanged SIG price, crossing spread plus declared fee/buffer; same common episode cohort.
controls.adverse_queue: Only matched original actual execution-distribution observations; no hypothetical passive fills.
controls.doubled_latency: Only original measured execution latency and actual corresponding later consumed executable book; otherwise unavailable.
controls.leave_one_event_out: Entire deduplicated event and overlapping 13-second ticker episode excluded; no event fragment leaks.

learning.model: Two fixed regime residual corrections to genuine supplied source-model executable-return predictions; no terminal probability or new generic lead-lag model.
learning.purge: Training label availability strictly precedes each OOS decision; held-out common cohort and all controls fixed before completeness.
learning.baseline_unavailable: No genuine retained trained source_innovation artifact/predictions means no correction fit or learned-value claim.

selection: First global (ticker,tradeId) representative by original decision/sample ID before features/labels; immutable event conflict quarantines whole key. First representative consumes 13s per ticker even when later censored. No replacement by a better-labeled event.
evidence: Known sealed trace replay and same reviewed sampler only. Preserve every skipped/censored/failed episode. Inspected historical cohorts are exploratory; prospective validation requires separately frozen uninspected cohort manifest.
capacity: Exact full-depth entry ask/exit bid prefixes for YES; complementary YES bid/ask prefixes for NO. Costs/fees counted once. Displayed crossing counterfactuals do not prove own fills, queue priority, principal turnover or executable strategy alpha.
